messages:
jonathan: Heads-up: planning a rolling soft-reboot + NIC firmware tune and a conservative NVMe driver micropatch for APAC edge (apac-west1/west2) + a small US-WEST cohort. Target window Sat 23:00 UTC. Expect ~3-5% capacity dip per cohort for ~20m while we drain pods. Need capacity hedging and comms.
ashley: ACK. Split APAC into 6 cohorts (~8 racks each), stagger by 30m. no more than 2 concurrent drains. Canary = apac-west1-rack-3 (low-traffic).
jonathan: Canary first. If canary passes 15m smoke, proceed. rollback & abort if failing.
kevin: Any impact to hosted latency/throughput during APAC peak? We have scheduled batch jobs Sat 00:30 local that might overlap.
maria: If concurrent drains <=2 we should be OK. Main risk is KV cache cold pressure -> prefix warmup recommended. Also suggest small inference probes after each cohort finishes.
jonathan: Will add automated probe job: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prime -d '{"prompt":"seed"}'` run twice after each cohort completes.
ashley: Ops playbook drain snippet:
```
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=60
# wait for pods to reschedule; verify readiness
kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide
```
Add `--grace-period=60` for model-workers to let graceful shutdown finish.
sre-bot: maintenance-ticket #INC-2026 created. ETA: Sat 23:00 UTC -> Sun 03:00 UTC. Notifying on-call.
kevin: Cost hedge Q: can we spin ephemeral burst capacity in us-west (spot GPUs) for ~2h to blunt customer impact? Budget ~$1.2k max.
maria: Spots ok short-term but need ~15m pre-warm. Recommend pre-provisioning 3 spot nodes 20m before start and keep alive to avoid scale-to-zero. Autoscaler must be primed.
jonathan: Plan: pre-warm US-WEST 3 spot nodes @ Sat 22:40 UTC, start APAC canary 23:00 UTC, cohorts every 30m until ~02:30 UTC; finish with a small US-WEST micro-cohort at ~02:45 UTC. Keepalive set.
ashley: Customer comms: short note to hosted-users, direct email to Dedicated/Private. @maria lead comms? include rollback criteria, SLA note, contact for ops.
maria: Will draft. I'll also flag scheduler to avoid heavy batch runs during 23:00-03:00 window and send T-24h and T-4h reminders.
kevin: Update billing tag `maintenance:apac-uxx-2026-04` so burst cost is traceable.
jonathan: Tagging done. I'll attach final cohort list and runbook to the ticket. Timeline pinned to ops calendar. Any objections to Saturday schedule?
ashley: no objections. :thumbsup:
maria: no objections. will send comms.
jonathan: Final runbook highlights: canary -> 6 cohorts staggered 30m, pre-warm 3 spot nodes @22:40 UTC, run 2 probe seeds after each cohort, billing tags set, rollback if canary fails. I'll paste full k8s cmds and smoke checks in the ticket.
deploy-bot: Reminder posted to #incidents and #support at 23:00 UTC. Incident page: https://internal.redwood/ops/INC-2026
kevin: Monitoring to watch during window: `ingress-p95`, `kv-cache-hit-rate`, `queue-length-inference`, `pod-restarts`. I'll monitor dashboards.
maria: I'll update status doc and customer comms. GLHF :rocket:
jonathan: Thanks all — I'll post the runbook link in this thread once attached to the ticket.
